date_scope_check.qualification_retained: R16-AN-001-R1: March 2018 is a documentary boundary, not the original onset. The WTO describes Senegalese trucks transferring loads to Mauritanian vehicles while Moroccan trucks continued operating; cargo itself was not prohibited. The reported July 11, 2025 agreement ended compulsory transshipment formally. A January 2026 bilateral communiqué instead dates lifting of the practice to November 2025. These accounts do not establish the first operational through-passage or explain the intervening implementation. The retrospective 2010 claim is not adopted as an exact original onset. Original policy rationale and uninterrupted operational enforcement remain unestablished.
